title: Wood and Glass
text:
Wood is a natural material. It comes from trees and it feels warm and smooth. Many chairs and tables are made of wood.

Glass is different. It is hard and it is cold to touch. You can see through glass, so windows are often made of it.

questions.text: Why are windows often made of glass?
options: Because light can pass through it
Because it is soft to touch
Because it is made of trees

questions.text: How would wood probably feel compared to glass?

vocabulary.definition: having an even surface with no rough parts
from one side to the other side of something
openings in a wall that let in light and air
to put your hand on something to feel it

paragraph_translations: La madera es un material natural. Viene de los árboles y se siente cálida y lisa. Muchas sillas y mesas están hechas de madera.
El vidrio es diferente. Es duro y frío al tacto. Se puede ver a través del vidrio, por eso las ventanas a menudo están hechas de él.
